newsitem.title: USA: Touch Tone America sees wider 1st half loss.
newsitem.headline: Touch Tone America sees wider 1st half loss.

text.p: Touch Tone America Inc said on Wednesday that it expects to report a loss of $2.2 million or $0.68 a share for the six months ended November 30, 1996, compared with a loss of $1.0 million or $0.67 a share for the year-earlier six-month period.
The company cited higher spending for its high capacity network backbone for Internet communications and declining revenues from its long distance operations for the wider loss.

Touch Tone also said that it expects to mail proxy materials in late January to it shareholders related to a special meeting to vote on its previously announced proposed acquisition of Arcada Communications.
